notes.title: 🕊️ Prepare to unveil the mysteries of Amerzone - The Explorer’s Legacy 🕊️
notes.content:
Hello Explorers,

Get in your hydraloft in search of the mythical Great White Birds when [i]Amerzone - The Explorer’s Legacy[/i] lands in 2024!

[previewyoutube=lQf1kBoskWw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Set off on a quest for the Great White Birds in a mysterious land full of secrets[/h2]

Answer the call of exploration as you travel to [b]Amerzone[/b], a forgotten Latin American country, to fulfill the last wishes of a late explorer.

Investigate the ruins of this secretive land reclaimed by nature, meet intriguing characters with deep backstories and solve intricate puzzles to uncover the truth.

[h2]Will you unveil the mysteries surrounding the mythical Great White Birds?[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11113189/bf2500829f737733cdcb5952f413f61ffe3fcf86.jpg[/img]

🌱 [b]A remake of the classic Benoît Sokal game[/b]
(Re)Discover the work of Benoît Sokal before the Syberia saga

🧭 [b]An ode to exploration[/b]
Discover a land shaped by mysteries and secrets as you travel through breathtaking environments

🕊️ [b]Face many challenges in search of the truth[/b]
Find clues and solve intricate puzzles to carry your quest for the Great White Birds in a faithful yet enriched story

🤝 [b]Meet fascinating characters[/b]
Learn about people with deep backstories, and listen to their stories to mend the errors of the past

🕊️ [b]Wishlist Amerzone - The Explorer’s Legacy now[/b]

notes.title: Discover a Detective's Beginning in Hercule Poirot: The First Cases
notes.content:
🍳    [b]In his early years as a detective[/b], a young Hercule Poirot is invited to a reception by the influential Van den Bosch family, for the announcement of their daughter’s engagement. But tensions among the guests run high as a snowstorm descends on the town, trapping everyone inside the manor. 

[previewyoutube=5mHhLhGEtSM;full][/previewyoutube]
The happy event is soon marred by the murder of one of the guests! Poirot being in the right place at the right time immediately begins to investigate. What buried secrets and deadly rivalries will he uncover?

[h3]Go check [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1573720/Agatha_Christie__Hercule_Poirot_The_First_Cases/?beta=0]AGATHA CHRISTIE - HERCULE POIROT: THE FIRST CASES[/url] on Steam![/h3]

notes.title: Agatha Christie - The ABC Murder: Major update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Today we are publishing a major update for Agatha Christie – The ABC Murders.

With this update we reworked several aspects of the game:

·        A brand-new "Brain cells" interface reinforcing player’s immersion
·        A smoother gameplay to provide a better experience
·        Now 4K compatible
·        Framerate increased from locked 30FPS to 60FPS
·        Addition of multiple tutorials to guide players
·        New lighting effects
·        Reworked sound design
·        New anti-aliasing more on par with the artistic direction of the game

With those new additions, there is no better time to rediscover one of Hercule Poirot's most famous investigations!

notes.title: Update for Agatha Christie - The ABC Murders !
notes.content:
In order to provide you with a better gaming experience during your investigations, we’ve improved the game’s graphics, sound and gameplay!

Here’s a summary of the improvements we’ve made:
•	Polish added
•	Brazilian-Portuguese added
•	Various improvements.
•	Correction of minor bugs


GRAPHICS AND ANIMATIONS
	Corrected lip-synchronization
	Improvement of certain characters’ animations
	Improvement of looks exchanged by characters during certain dialogues
SOUNDS
	Added/corrected voices
	Some sounds have been improved and added (puddle, doors opening, suitcase, movements, etc.)
TEXT
	Corrected texts
	Size of emotion text improved
GAMEPLAY
	Improved camera and camera animations in certain scenes
	Certain collision zones in the puzzles have been reworked
	Some collision adjustments in the “little grey cells” menu
